answer: Clique-Coupled Settlement Ledger. Each agent's actions settle through a shared ledger where every delta in its record must balance against a randomly drawn counterparty each epoch; unmatched balances roll forward as copper-weighted liabilities. An attacker must maintain live, reciprocal accounting with honest agents rather than disposable keys, paying per-identity the ongoing cost of real trades plus a pearl fee on any unreciprocated residual.
